embark: Embark on a journey through intricately designed mazes! This game challenges you to find your way from start to finish through a labyrinth of paths.

how_to_play.title: How to Play:
how_to_play.generate0: Use the Generate button to create a new maze.
how_to_play.solve0: Click on Solve to see the maze solved automatically using Breadth-First Search (BFS) or Depth-First Search (DFS) algorithms.
how_to_play.challenge: Or, take the challenge and try to solve the maze yourself! Simply click on the path you think is correct.
how_to_play.can_you: Can you find your way through the maze's twists and turns? Start your adventure now!
